verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīlādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādhādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññādhipateyyo.
verses.english: One individual doesn’t value or submit to ethics, immersion, or wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlagaru hoti sīlādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādhādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññādhipateyyo.
verses.english: One individual values and submits to ethics, but not to immersion or wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlagaru hoti sīlādhipateyyo, samādhigaru hoti samādhādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññādhipateyyo.
verses.english: One individual values and submits to ethics and immersion, but not wisdom.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlagaru hoti sīlādhipateyyo, samādhigaru hoti samādhādhipateyyo, paññāgaru hoti paññādhipateyyo.
verses.english: One individual values and submits to ethics, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”
